data.body: Landed: Gerrit 3486 merged as 904de16194b48a461271e4e160fdd96fffb1c88c (2026-11-20 14:52 PST), on origin/main. Patch set 1 (eafd914081e): LLM-Review +1, Verified -1 only from tests/unit/test_reclaim_resign.py, red on its parent and fixed on main by 2825b4fe283. Patch set 2 (2a827ee8368): rebased on origin/main and adds test_the_mapping_probe_honours_a_429_retry_after for the review advisory (it fails when the probe's rate_limit_retry opt-in is removed); make verify passed (21577 passed + 226 integration, 0 failed); LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved. AC evidence: Cloud comment create -> test_a_failed_cloud_comment_create_is_not_replayed (+429 still retried); DC create -> test_a_dc_create_that_may_have_landed_is_sent_once (3 fault types, raises builtin ConnectionError/TimeoutError) and test_a_lost_dc_create_is_recovered_by_label_not_replayed; DC comment -> test_a_dc_comment_that_may_have_landed_is_sent_once; max_retries=0 -> test_the_dc_client_is_built_without_library_retries. Accepted behaviour change (in plan): DC writes no longer get the jira library's hidden 429/5xx retry. Unverified: real jira library behaviour under max_retries=0 (source-read for 3.10.5, not installed in any test tier); no live DC instance exercised.
